configurations.//: autoPort is off on purpose. The bridge only accepts WebSocket origins on localhost:5173-5199 and 4173-4199, so a port picked outside that range starts a face that looks perfectly alive and can never reach the brain.
configurations.name: jarvis
configurations.//writes: "--", "--writes" lets JARVIS act — click and type in Edge, open apps, drive the phone, run shell. ON in this local copy. Remove those two args to go back to read-only, which is what a fresh clone (and the README) assumes.
